## Learning goals

- I can compare fonts at the size people will actually see.
- I can judge whether a background, outline, shadow, or 3D effect improves readability.
- I can keep style without letting effects hide the letter shapes.

::: {.callout-note}
The figures below come from the [Graphics Accommodation Guide](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1AfDpLSJQtKy7YUMdwL8-BBR81NTv9Ck_cyzQ4pA2Hk4/edit). They are kept beside the exact design decision they demonstrate.
:::
